premises.text: Developer toil from complexity wastes huge developer hours and drives unhappy developers to quit
premises.evidence_span: developers spend half their week in toil

premises.text: AppMap delivers personal observability of runtime software behavior inside the code editor as developers write code
premises.evidence_span: software developers can see the behavior of their software as they write code

premises.text: Runtime traces across services and data stores automatically surface performance and security issues while developers work
premises.evidence_span: AppMap automatically analyzes this information to find issues why developers work, and it alerts them if it finds a problem

premises.text: Deep language/framework integrations and open source support new languages and communities
premises.evidence_span: AppMap integrates deeply with popular languages and frameworks. And AppMap is open source

premises.text: Free for individuals and open source, with partnership paths for developer-focused organizations to deliver tools via runtime insights
